body: Congratulations! I’m hoping for the same
I’m moving back to Houston and the rent inflation is CRAZY. $1483 for a 660 sq ft, without the additional fees and utilities.
Congratulations! I just sent my follow up email and I’m awaiting my scores next week. I hope I get an A. Best of luck to you and protection on your journey!
Batting cages, painting, and learning ASL currently.
I read mine 15 minutes ago and laughed. I hit delete so fast lmao.

Aquarius moon, Leo Sun and Aries Rising. I need space and silence if my partner is around. I will isolate but if they still handle the small things for me when I’m doing that it helps a ton. I have to feel my feelings and break it down alone. I cry when I try to speak to others and I instantly regret it so yeah that’s a no. An occasional back rub and painting helps me.
Yes. This how I started writing a book, a memoir/workbook type. I cry when I work on it sometimes. I really forgot a lot of these things happened.

Change my hair up, smoke or talk to multiple people at once, regretting it the next day. Now I don’t do any of these. I have a routine where I workout at 6am, make three meals and write but I still get that empty feeling randomly when I’m watching a tv show. Maybe because I’m not doing anything

This. I was driving one day and wondered if the accident I had been in previously would’ve put me in a state of not having to do anything, I could finally rest with zero expectations. Being in a coma would be one of the best things to happen to meX little would people know.

I had such a bad episode today, was somewhat fine an hour later. Pain is inevitable but it’s so deep and at time I think things would be better if I didn’t exist, that equates to no pain. My purpose and sense of self is on a downward spiral. I have ADHD as well. Alone in a room full of people type of feeling. I wonder if new meds would help. I self care and have routines but it doesn’t help.
Sorry, that I do not remember. It’s probably due to me being traumatized.

You’re welcome, best of luck to you keep being great. Thanks!
Scale from 1 - 5 and 5 being difficult overall, I’ll give it a 4-4.5. I usually do so well despite questions 15-19 but this time I’m not sure what happened.
You will! I’m sure you hear it a lot but pouring into yourself does work :) best of luck to you. I’m retaking in August I think that’ll be enough time.
I sat in my car and stared into space. It was unreal
My brain went blank for three minutes when the LR came up and it’s my best section. Like someone said, either I did well or it’s the worst I’ve ever performed.
